text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 76 x 36 mm blank from 10 mm aluminium plate; file the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edges square and flat. Front view: the long face; top: the top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark a centre line both ways. Sizes are from those centre lines.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Magnet holes: two, 20 mm each side of centre on the long centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 5.0 mm through and tap M6 through. The left one (boss end)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: also takes the boss's set screw from the top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stand-off holes: four, 33 mm each side and 13 mm each side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 2.5 mm through and tap M3 through.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Use a drill press so the holes are square to the faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr; the top face must stay flat: the boss and stand-offs sit on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: magnets screw in from below, the boss on top over the left

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: magnet, the four stand-offs on top at the corners.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: an M6 screw turns in both holes by hand, square to the face.
